newsitem.title: USA: Diana Corp says 10-k filing delayed.
newsitem.headline: Diana Corp says 10-k filing delayed.

text.p: Diana Corp has raised more than $3.5 million from the sale of shares and warrant rights and said several developments will cause a delay in filing its Form 10-K for fiscal 1997.
It also said it received a $4.4 million judgment as a settlement in a lawsuit against a customer, which it expects to collect within two months. It is also a defendant in class action lawsuits.
The company said it has made progress and is making every effort to file its financial statements with the Securities and Exchange Commission as soon as possible.

The company said it is also reviewing other financing alternatives, including collateralized loans against certain non-operating assets, infusion of additional equity, divestiture of non-core business units and the sale of non-operating assets.
The company intends to use the net proceeds from its financing activities for working capital to support its core business unit, Sattel Communications, it said.
